# Pesher Habakkuk Column 6 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 6 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 6:2 — "with no one to rule them" vs. "that have no ruler over them"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "with-no-one to-rule them" | Literal participial form |
| LOGOS | "with no one to rule over them" | Adds preposition for clarity |
| PNEUMA | "that have no ruler over them" | Nominal restructuring |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "with no one to rule over them." The preposition clarifies without altering meaning.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 6:14 — "objects of worship" vs. "objects of veneration" vs. "objects of devotion"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "their-objects-of-worship" | Direct rendering |
| LOGOS | "their objects of veneration" | Elevated register |
| PNEUMA | "the objects of their devotion" | Dynamic rephrasing |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "their objects of worship" (EMET). Most direct and clear; "veneration" and "devotion" are euphemistic for what the text condemns as idolatry.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 6:17 — "laying waste" vs. "devastating" 
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "laying-waste many lands" | Literal for Hebrew hecherev |
| LOGOS | "devastating many lands" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "laying waste to many lands" | Adds preposition |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "devastating many lands." Slightly more fluid English.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 6: 3 | Covers Hab 1:14-16*
